caption: The drawing features a single bonnet, depicted in a slightly three-quarters view, positioned centrally on a neutral, light-colored background. The bonnet is outlined in pencil, with shaded areas suggesting folds and the curvature of fabric. The bonnet has a light tan or beige color, with a pattern of bluish-gray embroidered circular motifs surrounded by elongated stitches radiating outward, creating a floral or sunburst effect. Dotted, short parallel lines fill the spaces in between the motifs, arranged diagonally. The bonnet is edged by thin ties at both the front and lower edge, also rendered lightly in pencil. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, faint sketch showing an alternate or supporting view of the bonnet, with simplified patterns and the head of a person suggested inside the bonnet outline. The artist's signature, “Mary Ho...,” is written in small letters at the bottom right. The rest of the composition is blank, focusing attention on the detailed rendering of the bonnet.
title: Baby's Cap
